transforms.name: plural
transforms.description: Plural of a noun or adjective: libri, case, cani, problemi, amiche, parchi, amici, arance, figli.

transforms.name: feminine
transforms.description: Feminine singular of an adjective, or of a noun for a person: rossa, attrice, studentessa, padrona.

transforms.name: feminine plural
transforms.description: Feminine plural of an adjective: rosse, bianche, lunghe, lisce.

transforms.name: superlative
transforms.description: Absolute superlative (-issimo): bellissimo, grandissima, lunghissimi, velocissime.

transforms.name: adverb (-mente)
transforms.description: Adverb formed from an adjective with -mente: lentamente, fortemente, facilmente, regolarmente.

transforms.name: present (io)
transforms.description: Present indicative, first person singular (io): parlo, temo, dormo, finisco.

transforms.name: present (tu)
transforms.description: Present indicative, second person singular (tu): parli, temi, dormi, finisci.

transforms.name: present (lui, lei)
transforms.description: Present indicative, third person singular (lui, lei, Lei): parla, teme, dorme, finisce.

transforms.name: present (noi)
transforms.description: Present indicative, first person plural (noi): parliamo, temiamo, dormiamo, finiamo.

transforms.name: present (voi)
transforms.description: Present indicative, second person plural (voi): parlate, temete, dormite, finite.

transforms.name: present (loro)
transforms.description: Present indicative, third person plural (loro): parlano, temono, dormono, finiscono.

transforms.name: imperfect (io)

transforms.name: imperfect (loro)

transforms.name: past participle (-rsi verb)

transforms.name: infinitive
transforms.description: An infinitive that lost its final e before an attached pronoun: parlarlo, vederti, dormirne, porlo, condurla, farlo.

transforms.name: pronoun before the verb
transforms.description: A pronoun written before a verb: mi lavo, ti ricordi, si accorge, ci vuole, se ne va, me la cavo, c'entra, m'alzo.

transforms.name: -rsi verb
transforms.description: A verb with a reflexive pronoun before it or attached to it, looked up in its -rsi form: mi lavo → lavarsi, ti ricordi → ricordarsi, se ne va → andarsene, me la cavo → cavarsela, alzati → alzarsi.

transforms.name: pronoun of the next verb
transforms.description: A pronoun before stare or a modal that belongs to the gerund or infinitive after it: mi sto preparando → prepararsi, si sta divertendo → divertirsi, mi devo alzare → alzarsi, me ne voglio andare → andarsene.
